districts.name: Kai Tak
districts.description: Kai Tak Outline Zoning Plan S/K22/9 planning scheme area (Planning Department, published 2026-07-17). Served by the government-run Kai Tak District Cooling System. Not an administrative district: it straddles Kowloon City and Kwun Tong districts.

districts.name: Central and Western
districts.description: Dense commercial core (Central, Sheung Wan) with mixed residential on the slopes.

districts.name: Kwun Tong
districts.description: Industrial-to-commercial transition area (Kowloon East), adjacent to Kai Tak.

districts.name: Sha Tin
districts.description: Residential-led new town with large retail podiums.
